balancingDefinitions.joint: qc_weight divided by station event count times storm event count
balancingDefinitions.normalization: all schemes rescaled to sum to event count
balancingDefinitions.station: qc_weight divided by the station event count
balancingDefinitions.storm: qc_weight divided by the storm event count

fixedHoldoutEvaluation.policy: one post-selection evaluation per fixed regional holdout

globalPriorLeaveOneRegionOut.method: station-balanced mean log(observed_slr / baseline_slr) on other development-region training events

northeastFinal.conclusion: The prior transfers on development-region holdouts but fails on untouched Northeast; do not use a global fallback.

limitations: Retrospective diagnostic on four retained regional datasets; not a production validation.
Hyperparameters are shared, but coefficients are fitted separately within each region.
Contiguous storm CV holds out complete chronological storm blocks but is not forward-chaining.
Cluster bootstrap intervals describe sampling variability across the respective observed station or storm clusters within each fixed holdout only.
Grouped-crossfit intervals are empirical heuristics without finite-sample, exchangeability, or group-conditional coverage guarantees.
No artifact is emitted and production calibration remains disabled.

empiricalGroupedCrossfitIntervals80.warning: Pooled event residuals from grouped cross-fits are used only as an empirical interval heuristic. They do not establish event exchangeability, cluster-level exchangeability, group-conditional coverage, or a finite-sample conformal guarantee.

northeastUntouchedEvaluation.evaluationPolicy: single post-selection evaluation after training-only grouped-CV choices were frozen

rootCauseDiagnostic.interpretation: The aggregate log-residual changes sign from training to test. Training-station means occupy a comparatively narrow negative-to-near-zero range, while held-out station means span both negative and strongly positive values. The existing hierarchy therefore applies a near-uniform regional correction with the wrong aggregate sign and cannot represent held-out-station heterogeneity.

predictors.fullFeatureDefinition: thermal profile plus retained precipitation, snowfall, elevation, baseline SLR, SWE proxy, and profile-hour count
predictors.note: Only retained temperature2mC, freezingLevelHeightM, pressure-level temperature/geopotential, precipitationMm, snowfallCm, elevation, baseline SLR and SWE proxy fields are used; no humidity or wind is synthesized.
predictors.thermalAblationDefinition: temperature2m, freezing-level, and pressure-level temperature/geopotential summaries only

purpose: methodology diagnostic only; no production artifact or runtime modification

foldFamilies.contiguous_storm: up to five deterministic contiguous chronological blocks of complete storm groups; no storm crosses folds

trainingGroupedCvSelection.holdoutIsolation: fixed regional holdouts were excluded from all candidate scoring
trainingGroupedCvSelection.objective: equal-weight macro mean across regions; each region score is the equal-weight mean of unseen-station and contiguous-storm event MAE

usLabelProvenanceWarning.warning: All selected U.S. labels are source-N/CoCoRaHS: Rockies 148/148 N; Sierra 197 SNOW:N/WESF:N plus 48 SNOW:7/WESF:N; Northeast 179/179 N. NOAA documentation defines source N as CoCoRaHS. The later strict broad-U.S. audit excludes source N because underlying reuse and commercial-training authorization was not positively established. This does not assert illegality; authorization is unresolved. U.S. results therefore remain research-only even where physical pairs pass non-circular quality control.
